newsitem.title: MEXICO: Up to 17 die in Mexico bus plunge - reports.
newsitem.headline: Up to 17 die in Mexico bus plunge - reports.

text.p: A speeding bus plunged down a 660-feet (200-meter) ravine in central Mexico on Wednesday killing up to 17 passengers and injuring 23 others, the state news agency Notimex said.
It said the Omnibus de Mexico bus veered off a widely travelled highway between Mexico and the U.S. border in the central state of Hidalgo, some 125 miles (200 kms) north of the capital.

The road winds through perilous, fog-covered mountains, and Notimex quoted Hidalgo State Government Secretary Juan Carlos Alva Calderon Interior Minister as saying the bus failed to make a curve and plunged down the canyon due to "an excess of speed."
He said many of the injured were seriouslu hurt. The driver of the bus was missing, Notimex reported.
Earlier television reports put the death toll at 14.
